items.title: arifgans: rebrand kernel + enable NetHunter (Kali) feature set
items.body:
## Summary

Rebrands the kernel from **"Kono Ha"** to **"ArifGans"** and enables a **kABI-safe NetHunter (Kali) feature set** in `build.sh`. SukiSU + SUSFS were already supported by the existing build matrix (`variant=susfs root=sukisu`); no workflow logic change was required for that combo.

### Rebrand
| Where | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `arch/arm64/configs/konoha_defconfig` | `CONFIG_LOCALVERSION="-Kono-Ha-Kernel"` | `CONFIG_LOCALVERSION="-ArifGans-Kernel"` |
| `anykernel/anykernel.sh` | `kernel.string=Kono Ha Kernel` / `ui_print "Flashing Kono Ha Kernel..."` | `ArifGans Kernel` |
| `build.sh` | `Kono-Ha-*.zip` / `Kono-Ha-Release` | `ArifGans-*.zip` / `ArifGans-Release` (keeps `Kono-Ha-Release` alias for backwards compatibility with downstream tooling) |
| `.github/workflows/build.yml` and `build-custom.yml` | artifact name `Kono-Ha-*`, path `Kono-Ha-Release` | `ArifGans-*`, `ArifGans-Release` |

### NetHunter / Kali feature set
Applied via `scripts/config` in `build.sh`, between defconfig load and `olddefconfig`, so kconfig resolves the dependency tree cleanly. Everything is either built-in (`-e`) or module (`-m`); no symbol exports change vs `android/abi_gki_aarch64_qcom`.

- **USB gadget** — HID, RNDIS, ECM_SUBSET, MASS_STORAGE, FunctionFS (BadUSB / Rubber-Ducky, Windows-RNDIS tethering, USB mass-storage attack)
- **USB-Serial** — ACM, PL2303, CH341, FTDI_SIO, CP210X, OPTION (HC-05, GPS dongles, microcontrollers)
- **Bluetooth** — HCIBTUSB, HCIUART (external BT adapters)
- **Mobile broadband** — USB_HSO
- **Diagnostics** — NETLINK_DIAG, PACKET_DIAG, INET_DIAG (raw/udp), UNIX_DIAG  (powers `ss`, `tcpdump`, `iftop`, etc.)
- **nftables** — NF_TABLES + INET/NETDEV/CT/NAT/MASQ/REDIR/REJECT/LOG/LIMIT/HASH/FIB/TPROXY/SOCKET/XFRM/SYNPROXY/COMPAT
- **Bridge netfilter** — BRIDGE_NETFILTER, NF_CONNTRACK_BRIDGE, BRIDGE_NF_EBTABLES + full BRIDGE_EBT_* set (MITM, ARP spoofing, ebtables)
- **xt matches** — ADDRTYPE, DCCP, SCTP, CGROUP, CONNLABEL, RECENT, STATISTIC, STRING, TIME, U32, NFACCT, PHYSDEV
- **Namespacing** — VETH, USER_NS

### SukiSU + SUSFS build
No code change needed — the build matrix in `.github/workflows/build.yml` already produces these variants on every push to `main`:
- `susfs-sukisu-{powersave|balance|performance|ultra-performance}` ± `-kpm` ± `-hardened` ± `-bypasscharging`
- `root-sukisu-...` (same matrix without SUSFS)

For a targeted ad-hoc build, `.github/workflows/build-custom.yml` exposes `workflow_dispatch` with `variant=susfs` + `root=sukisu` inputs. After this PR is merged, the daily/manual CI will publish `ArifGans-*.zip` artifacts under `ArifGans-Release/`.

## Review & Testing Checklist for Human

This touches kernel `.config`, so it's **yellow risk**. CI green is necessary but not sufficient — the kernel must actually boot on the target device and the NetHunter userspace must see the new kernel features.

- [ ] **Boot the built `ArifGans-susfs-sukisu-*.zip`** on the target device. Verify `/proc/version` reports `*-ArifGans-Kernel-*`.
- [ ] **Run `setup-nethunter`** from the NetHunter store / chroot and confirm Kali userspace comes up. Check that `nft list ruleset`, `ss -tulnp`, `tcpdump -i any`, and `ip netns add foo` all work (validates NF_TABLES, NETLINK_DIAG, PACKET_DIAG, VETH/USER_NS).
- [ ] **USB HID injection** — plug device into a host PC, run `hid-keyboard` from NetHunter, confirm keystrokes register on the host (validates `USB_CONFIGFS_F_HID` + RNDIS gadget chain).
- [ ] **External Wi-Fi adapter** (e.g. TP-Link TL-WN722N) plugged via OTG — confirm it enumerates as `wlan1` once you load the vendor `.ko` (this PR does not enable `CFG80211`/`MAC80211` so external Wi-Fi injection still requires loading wireless stack modules from vendor or a separate fragment; see Notes below).
- [ ] **SukiSU manager + SUSFS** — open SukiSU app, confirm root grants; flash a Magisk module; open Shamiko/SUSFS module and confirm `nft`, `ss`, `tcpdump` are hidden from props.

### Notes
- **kABI**: Every new config in `NETHUNTER_ARGS` was filtered for not touching `android/abi_gki_aarch64_qcom` exports. The bulk are `=m` so they live as out-of-tree modules and don't reshape the GKI ABI surface. If `make olddefconfig` later drops any symbol because a parent dep is missing in this tree (e.g. `BRIDGE_EBT_*` if `BRIDGE_NF_EBTABLES` can't resolve), the build will still succeed — those particular ebtables submodules just won't be packaged. The CI artifact log will show which `NETHUNTER_ARGS` survived.
- **Wireless injection / monitor-mode** is intentionally **not** wired up here. The base kernel has `CONFIG_CFG80211` unset, and turning it on would also require `MAC80211` + a vendor-Wi-Fi-driver review for kABI breakage. That's a separate, larger change — please open a follow-up issue if you need it.
- **Defconfig diff is intentionally tiny** (only `CONFIG_LOCALVERSION`). All other feature toggling lives in `build.sh` so it's centrally documented, easy to disable, and doesn't churn the 8k-line defconfig.
- **`Kono-Ha-Release` alias** is preserved alongside `ArifGans-Release` so any downstream uploader / release-asset script keyed on the old path keeps working until you migrate it.
